evidence.title: Beautiful themes for shadcn/ui — tweakcn | Theme Editor & Generator

name: tweakcn
summary: Visual theme editor for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS: adjust tokens with live preview, then copy or install the theme.
description: A no-code theme editor and generator for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4. Adjust color tokens (background, foreground, border, input, ring, primary, accent, chart 1-5) with a live preview of dashboard, calendar and form components, then copy the generated CSS variables or install a preset. 36 theme presets are served in shadcn registry format; free plan plus a pro plan.
contains: no-code visual editor for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4 themes
edit color tokens with live dashboard, calendar and form previews
exports theme CSS variables and copy-ready theme code
36 theme presets in shadcn registry format
free plan plus a pro plan
